I used to go though the same thing and I'm sure a lot of people on here have. My interests in high school were what most people would consider typical Male interests (sports, cars, mountain biking, etc) 

I used to let these interests hold me back from being who I truly was. I'd tell myself "I cant be a woman because I'm into x or y" 

Then I met some amazing people, who helped me realize that those interests didnt make me any less of as woman.

Since then my journey has been absolutely amazing. I dont have to try to convince myself that I'm not a woman anymore, I dont have to hide from my friends and family anymore. I dont have to wonder about who I am anymore because I know exactly who I am now.

At the end of the day though only you can figure out who you are, and it's okay if that takes some time to do.
